name: Hollow Body Rock with Weight
description: A hollow body hold performed while holding a plate overhead, then rocking forward and back to add dynamic challenge. The weight increases the anti-extension demand while the rocking motion adds timing and coordination elements. This is a staple of gymnastics conditioning.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Hollow Body Rock with Weight in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Hollow Body Rock with Weight.
steps: Step 1: Lie on back holding plate overhead. Create hollow body by pressing back flat.
Step 2: Raise arms, head, and legs off floor into hollow position.
Step 3: Rock forward and back while maintaining hollow shape.
Step 4: Keep the same curve throughout the rocking motion.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
common_mistakes: Losing hollow position on the rock
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Same shape throughout the entire rock
